scope: Actual main.ts state-transition functions with inert DOM/scene fixtures; no visual rendering claim
checks: Actual moving aperture is sampled continuously in viewport coordinates, camera progress reaches ArchiveScene, and array return cannot flash the reading article
Esc/back invalidates the pending RAF and hides the never-exposed article synchronously
A modal interrupts extraction, preserves its opener, and cannot be overtaken by a pending projection
Reading-origin projection returns to the same reading surface without rerender or scroll reset
An explicit reading request takes over a pending extraction without a stale projection opening
Without a 3D carrier the fallback comes from the actual triggering control and keeps the article inert
A modal during a still-extracting reading-origin request retains the reading route and cancels stale projection work
Natural first entry remains on the array with the first archive sealed; an explicit read starts unsealing only after physical clearance
Explicit wallpaper detail playback and frozen reference review retain their opt-in timeline
Entering a different reading session clears the previous opaque paper before revealing its UI container
Reduced motion still requires intentional activation and does not wait for suppressed extraction motion
Ordinary reading arrows retain native scrolling while array and gamepad navigation remain available
Esc during extraction preserves the originating reading or array route and cancels the queued projection
